title: Composer hint 'Shift + Enter for a new line' floats mid-height while the send button sits at the bottom
detail: The composer row is align-items:flex-end (send docks to the bottom edge) but the hint is align-self:center. With one line the three items already sit on three different centres (placeholder line ~759, hint 769, send 780 in a 60px textarea); as the textarea grows the hint drifts into the middle of the right side, detached from both the text and the send button. It is also shown on iPad (touch, often no hardware keyboard), where Shift+Enter means nothing.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/composer-multiline-crop.png (5 lines: hint y=729, send y=760..800, textarea 675..800); chat-mac.png; chat-ipad.png shows the hint on touch. css/views/assistant.css:214 (.k-asst-composer align-items:flex-end), :220 (.k-asst-hint align-self:center); js/modules/assistant.js:913 (hint omitted only when compact)
fix: Give the hint align-self:flex-end with a margin-block-end that puts its centre on the send button's centre (or move it under the box as a small caption, left of the send). Hide it under (pointer:coarse) / when no hover, not only in compact mode.
rootCause: .k-asst-hint align-self:center inside a flex-end row

title: Opening a Morning/Evening review notification lands on Routines Today and never opens the review
detail: The review notice is pushed with view 'routines' and arg {review: slot}. KOS.notify.open() calls KOS.show('routines', {review:'morning'}), but KOS.views.routines only reads arg.edit or a tab string, so the arg is dropped and the page shows Routines › Today. The review sheet does not open; the user has to find the header chip. The same item reaches the bell, the Notifications page and closed-app pushes (sw notificationclick → kos-open → KOS.show), so all three dead-end.
evidence: eval: clicking the 'Morning review' row on #/notifications → location.hash '#/routines', no dialog open. js/core/dayreview.js:713 (view:'routines', arg:{review:slot}); js/core/notify.js:196-199 (open); js/modules/routines.js:469-473 (arg.review never read); grep finds no reader of arg.review anywhere.
fix: In KOS.views.routines (or better, in notify.open for kind 'review') call KOS.reviewSheet.open(arg.review) after drawing Today, the way the header chip opens it.
rootCause: Producer and consumer of the notification's arg disagree; no handler for {review}

title: History's 'Open Account & Cloud Sync' button opens the Collection's Sync & Import page, which has no sign-in
detail: Assistant › History, signed out, shows 'History is kept after cloud sign-in' with a button 'Open Account & Cloud Sync'. It calls KOS.show('mediasync'), the Collection's Sync & Import page (AniList, VNDB, Games…), which has no email/password fields. The sign-in card lives on Archive › Backup & Restore (#/data). The user lands on the wrong page with no way forward.
evidence: js/modules/assistant.js:2075 onclick KOS.show("mediasync"); eval KOS.show('mediasync') → headings 'Sync & Import, AniList, VNDB, Games…', no input[type=email]; the sign-in form is on #/data (shots/assistant-archive/data-mac.png).
fix: KOS.show('data') and focus the account card's email field (one shared helper, e.g. KOS.cloudUI.openSignIn(), used by every 'sign in first' message).
rootCause: Hard-coded wrong view id

title: Every 'sign in first' message points to 'Archive → Account & Cloud Sync', a page that does not exist, and offers no button
detail: The Assistant's failure card (signed out, the default Gemini route), Memory's empty state, cloud.js, gameapi.js and vndb.js all say 'Archive → Account & Cloud Sync'. The Archive has no page of that name: the strip reads Backup & Restore, Help & Guide, Notifications, Files, Storage, Pen and ink, Connections; the card is a section inside Backup & Restore. Connections calls it 'Open Backup & cloud'. None of the Assistant's messages is a link. A first-time user who types a question gets 'Kurenai couldn't finish that' with directions to a page they cannot find, while the status pill still says 'Kurenai is with you' with a green dot.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-send-signedout-mac.png; shots/assistant-archive/memory-mac.png; js/core/ai.js:152,154; js/modules/assistant.js:2299; js/core/cloud.js:142-143; js/core/gameapi.js:23,25; js/core/vndb.js:112,281; js/core/ui.js:430-438 (Archive strip names)
fix: Name it as the UI does ('Archive › Backup & Restore › Account & Cloud Sync') and render an inline 'Sign in' action on the Assistant error card and the Memory/History empty states that opens #/data with the email field focused. Signed out with no Ollama model, show a one-line notice above the composer before the first send instead of failing after it.
rootCause: Navigation text duplicated in many string literals instead of one link helper; page renamed in review A

title: Assistant's side status card prints the full error as an uppercase letter-spaced eyebrow, cut off mid-word
detail: After a failed request the character panel's state label becomes 'FAILED: SIGN IN TO CLOUD SYNC FIRST (ARCHIVE → ACCOUNT & CLOUD SYNC) — THE ONLINE ASSIST…' in the 11px tracked uppercase eyebrow style across four lines and ellipsed. An eyebrow is for two-word labels; this is a sentence and is the same text the chat already shows in its error card.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-send-signedout-mac.png (bottom-right card); js/modules/assistant.js:724 setVisual('error', 'Failed: ' + clampText(p.message, 80))
fix: Set the label to a short state ('Couldn't finish') and leave the message in the thread.
rootCause: State label fed the provider error text

title: 'Undoable' Assistant actions cannot be undone: the undo each tool returns is collected and never offered
detail: Permissions labels every reversible tool 'Undoable action' / 'Default · runs, undoable', and the Assistant runs them without asking on that promise. Each such tool hands back an undo ({label, run}); the orchestrator pushes it into req.undos and lastUndos, but no UI ever reads KOS.ai.orchestrator.lastUndos(): the 'Verified action complete' card has only text (no Undo), no toast offers one, and Activity is read-only. Reproduced with a stubbed Ollama returning todo_add_task: the reminder 'Revise BFS and DFS' was created, the card shows 'Add task / done / Target · #1 / todo_add_task' and the thread's only button is Copy. The only way back is to find and delete the record by hand.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-tool-add-mac.png; eval: buttons in .k-asst-thread = ['Copy'], state.reminders.items[0].title 'Revise BFS and DFS'. js/core/aitools.js:1919-1920 (undo returned); js/core/aiorchestrator.js:754 (req.undos.push), :451, :1046 (lastUndos exposed); grep finds no caller of lastUndos/undos outside aiorchestrator.js; js/modules/assistant.js:2518 ('runs, undoable')
fix: Render an Undo button on each verified-action card (and a toast with Undo, as Day Review does) wired to that call's undo.run, marking the card and the audit row 'Undone'. Keep it available until the conversation changes.
rootCause: Undo plumbing finished in the orchestrator but the presentation half was never built

title: Verified-action card shows internals: raw tool id, 'done', and 'Target · #1'
detail: After a tool runs, the card reads 'VERIFIED ACTION COMPLETE / Add task / done / Target · #1 / todo_add_task'. 'done' is the raw status, '#1' an internal record id, and 'todo_add_task' the function name. The useful fact (the reminder's title 'Revise BFS and DFS', where it went) is missing, and there is no link to open the reminder.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-tool-add-mac.png
fix: Show the human result ("Added 'Revise BFS and DFS' to Reminders") with an Open link to the record and Undo; keep the tool id for Activity only.
rootCause: Card renders the tool result envelope directly

title: Activity (signed out) shows every action as 'Proposed … Started' forever, with no time
detail: Signed out, Activity reads the local audit queue but keeps only the 'insert' rows and drops every 'update' (executed/declined/failed), so an action that ran reads 'Proposed', 'todo_add_task · proposed' and '● Started' in one row. The queued rows have no created_at, so the 'when' column is an empty 100px gap at the row's left. The filters Ran / Declined / Failed never match anything signed out.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/activity-after-mac.png (after a todo_add_task that the chat reported complete). js/modules/assistant.js:2587-2590 (filter r.kind === 'insert'); js/core/aiorchestrator.js:232-250 (status changes are separate 'update' rows; the insert payload has no created_at)
fix: When reading the queue, fold each 'update' patch into its insert by id and use the queue entry's ts as created_at.
rootCause: Queue reader ignores update rows; insert payload lacks a timestamp

title: No space between consecutive blocks in an Assistant reply (table runs straight into the code block)
detail: In a reply with a table followed by a fenced code block, the table's bottom edge and the code block's top edge touch (both margins 0px), so the two read as one box.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-tool-add-mac.png; eval: table bottom 560.7 = codeblock top 560.7, margin-bottom/top 0px
fix: Give the message body a flow gap (e.g. .k-asst-msg-body > * + * { margin-block-start: var(--sp-10) }) instead of per-element margins.
rootCause: Rich blocks (.k-asst-table, .k-asst-codeblock) carry no block spacing

title: Reopened chat starts at the oldest message, and from then on new replies and approval cards land off-screen
detail: The thread only follows the tail when it was already within 60px of the bottom. On first render the scroller is still detached, so render() sets scrollTop on a 0-height box and, once mounted, the thread shows the TOP of the conversation. Every later render measures 'not at bottom' and keeps scrollTop 0: the user's own sent message, Kurenai's reply and the 'Confirm & run / Decline' approval card all appear below the fold while the side panel says 'Waiting for your approval'. Reproduced: leave the Assistant and return (thread scrollTop 0 of 1110, client 617), send a message → scrollTop still 0, scrollHeight 1268; the approval card for todo_delete_task was in the DOM but not visible.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/chat-approval-mac.png (approval pending, card not visible, thread at top); eval {reopen:{st:0,sh:1110,ch:617}, after send:{st:0,sh:1268}}. js/modules/assistant.js:1615-1623 (atBottom measured before the scroller is in the document; no scroll on own send or on a pending card)
fix: Scroll to the end after the first mount (requestAnimationFrame after insertion) and always when the user sends or a confirmation card appears; keep the 'only if at bottom' rule only for streamed additions, and show a 'New message ↓' pill when not following.
rootCause: atBottom computed on a detached node; no explicit scroll on send/approval

title: Import backup replaces everything on this device the moment a file is picked: no confirmation, no summary, no undo
detail: On Archive > Data, 'Import backup…' opens the file picker and the change handler calls store.importFull immediately. The only warning ('A complete restore, not a merge: the file replaces what's here') is a title tooltip, invisible on iPad/iPhone. Picking an older backup by mistake silently replaces state, media, money, reviews, Mind, creatives and files; when signed in, importFull then calls KOS.cloudsync.noteRestore(), which re-baselines the cloud (push everything, tombstone remote rows the backup lacks), so the mistake propagates to every device. Reproduced: seeded slot with an extra money transaction tZ; importing an older backup through the real file input removed tZ with no dialog (dialog:false).
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/rt18/ink2.js result {money:['tA','tB'] (tZ gone), dialog:false}; js/modules/hub.js:3356-3378 (onchange -> importFull directly), 3376 title-only warning; js/core/store.js:623 replaceState before any check of what is lost, :727 noteRestore
fix: Before restoring, parse the file and show a KOS.ui.openDialog danger confirm (Cancel focused) naming the backup's date and counts against what is on this device now, offering 'Export a backup of this device first'; say that a signed-in device will overwrite the cloud copy.
rootCause: Restore was wired as a direct file-input action; the danger-dialog pattern used by Reset was never applied to the equally destructive import.

title: Restoring a backup MERGES handwriting instead of replacing it (every other store is cleared first)
detail: A full restore is documented as a replace. Media, files, money, reviews, Mind and Creatives importAll all clear their stores first; KOS.ink.importAll only puts, so notebooks/pages that exist on the device but not in the backup survive, and the ink sync base/dead stores are left describing pages the restore may have changed. Reproduced: an extra ink doc topic:cs:4.1.2 added before import is still there afterwards while the extra money transaction was removed.
evidence: rt18/ink2.js result inkDocs ['topic:cs:4.1.1','topic:cs:4.1.2'] vs money ['tA','tB']; js/core/ink.js:531-541 (no clear) vs js/core/money.js:1097, js/core/mediadb.js:1373-1374, js/core/reviewlog.js:108, js/core/mindjournal.js:167, js/core/creatives.js:467
fix: Clear docs, pages, base and dead (and reset the in-memory index) in ink.importAll before putting the backup's pages, like the other stores.
rootCause: ink.importAll was written as an additive put, unlike the shared clear-then-put pattern of the other importAll functions.

title: Full backup leaves out saved Reports (weeks, months, words) and Money pot pictures, so a restore loses them
detail: snapshotFull serialises state, media, files, money tx, reviews, Mind, ink and creatives, but not kurenai-os-reports (saved reports and boundary snapshots, which invariant 101/102 say are saved once and never recomputed, including Kurenai-written words) nor kurenai-os-money's 'pics' store (a pot's own picture). Round trip on the seeded account: 11 saved reports before, 5 after restore into an empty slot (all September and early-October weeks gone; only those the app could re-backfill came back, now without their original snapshots/words); pics never appear in the file. Signed-out users (no kos_reports replication) lose them permanently.
evidence: Round trip: /tmp/kosqa18-before.json reports 11 -> after restore 5 (keys month:2026-09, month:2026-10, week:2026-10-12/19/26); backup keys = state, mediaEntries, mediaKV, attachments, creatives, ink, mind, money{tx,del}, reviews; js/core/store.js:513-585 (no reportStore / pics step); js/core/money.js:1079-1090 exports TX/DEL only
fix: Add KOS.reportStore.exportAll/importAll (reports + snapshots) and the money pics store to snapshotFull/importFull and the report list in the toast; update the Data page's 'What a backup covers'.
rootCause: Each new IndexedDB was added to the backup by hand; reports and pot pictures were missed and nothing checks the backup covers every kurenai-os-* database.

title: Scheduled tab's day buttons are 32x44 ovals on iPad and iPhone
detail: The seven M T W T F S S day toggles in the Scheduled form are circles on the Mac but the coarse-pointer minimum raises only their height, so on touch devices each is a 32px-wide, 44px-tall oval (invariant 69: a round control must raise its width too).
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/sched-ipad.png; DOM measure at ipad and iphone: every 'Monday'..'Sunday' button 32x44; css/views/assistant.css:464 (.k-asst-day inline-size: var(--hit) with border-radius 50%)
fix: Under (pointer: coarse) set inline-size and min-inline-size to the touch hit size as well (or use the shared round-icon-button primitive).
rootCause: Width bound to --hit while the global coarse rule only lifts min-block-size.

title: Toggling a notification filter (or any Notifications switch) redraws the page and drops keyboard focus to <body>
detail: Each switch on #/notifications (Notification filters, Device alerts, Quiet hours) calls KOS.notify.setMuted/setQuiet, which emits and the whole view is rebuilt; the switch the user just pressed is replaced, so focus falls to MAIN/BODY. A keyboard or switch-control user toggling 15 filters must tab back from the top after every one. Scroll position is kept.
evidence: eval: after clicking the 'Calendar notifications' switch swStill:false, activeElement MAIN; after 'Daily Review' activeElement BODY; js/modules/notifications.js:320-321, js/core/notify.js:102-108 (emit), :115-119
fix: Update the switch and counts in place (or restore focus by data-ui/aria-label after the redraw, as KOS.rerender does for other views).
rootCause: The notify change event triggers a full view rebuild instead of a targeted update, with no focus restoration.

title: Morning Review text has a double full stop and lower-cases the warning's title ('revision block 24 is 7 days away..')
detail: The template appends ': ' + body.toLowerCase() + '.' to a warning body that already ends with a full stop, giving 'away..', and lower-cases proper nouns and codes inside it (an exam named 'AQA 7517 Paper 1' becomes 'aqa 7517 paper 1'). Visible in the notification feed and the review.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/notif-seeded-mac.png (Morning review row: 'Exam season is on: revision block 24 is 7 days away.. A good first task'); js/core/dayreview.js:540; body built at js/core/exams.js:1078
fix: Strip a trailing full stop before appending and do not lower-case the body (lower-case only the first character if needed).
rootCause: String concatenation assumes the warning body has no punctuation and no proper nouns.

title: Permissions on iPhone: each area's disclosure chevron is pushed off-screen and the filter field floats unaligned
detail: At 402px the area summary row (tile, name, count, tier dots, chevron) is wider than the card, so the chevron sits at x=414-420 outside the 402px viewport and the open/closed state is invisible. The 'Filter tools' field is a 200px-wide, 32px-tall box pushed right, starting about 50px in while the text above starts at 16px, beside a 44px 'Reset to defaults' button.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/perm-iphone.png; eval at iphone: .k-asst-chev rect [414,385,6,20], parent row [38..364]; filter 200x32 vs Reset 44 tall; js/modules/assistant.js:2494, 2545-2553
fix: Let the summary row wrap (tier dots onto a second line) or drop the tool count at phone width; make the filter fill the row width under 560px and match the button height.
rootCause: Desktop flex row with fixed widths and no phone tier.

title: Help & Guide is badly out of date: no entry for the Assistant, Money, Goals, Reports, Exams hub, Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives, Achievements or Connections, and several entries describe removed features
detail: The guide's eight sections stop at roughly the Collection/Pacing era. Searching 'japanese' or 'assistant' returns 'Nothing matches'; 'money' finds only 'Kurenai's words'; 'goal' finds only 'Planner', which still says 'The Planner workspace holds Budget Planner and Goals under one secondary tab bar' (gone: invariant 27). Other stale text: Overview describes 'overall completion ring, today's to-do... flagged topics' (Home is Up next / Today / Upcoming / Today's three now); search covers 'all three subjects' (there are seven study spaces); 'Today's directives... Ticks earn XP'; Cloud Sync lives at 'Archive → Account & Cloud Sync'; Gold omits the picture-upload unlocks (roadmap 5.14); section names 'The Behavioural Governor' and 'The Collection Matrix' no longer match the rail (Governor, Collection › Overview); 'Data & housekeeping' has a '·' instead of a kanji mark. Invariant 50a sends readers to Help for rules, so the gaps matter.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/help-seed-mac.png, help-iphone.png; eval guide search: {japanese:'Nothing matches', assistant:'Nothing matches', money:['Kurenai\'s words'], goal:['Planner']}; js/modules/help.js:9-110 (SECTIONS), :11, :13, :57, :61, :79, :106
fix: Add a section per study space and per Productivity/Archive page added since (Assistant, Money, Goals, Reports, Exams hub, Achievements, Connections, Wishlist), rewrite the stale entries, give every section a kanji, and add a smoke check that every rail view has a Help entry.
rootCause: Help is a hand-maintained array with no test tying it to the registered views, so each release added pages without guide entries.

title: After a backup restore the rail's profile card and the file index stay stale (Level 1, 0 gold; 'No files on this device yet')
detail: importFull replaces the state and the IndexedDBs in place and the Data page then calls only refreshRailCounters and KOS.show('home'). KOS.refreshHUD is never called, so the rail/phone profile card keeps the pre-restore Governor (here 'Level 1, Healthy, 0 gold' while the restored state is level 53 with 12,476 gold) until a session is logged or the app reloads; and KOS.files' in-memory index is not rebuilt, so Storage says 'No files on this device yet' / 'Every file is linked somewhere' and Files is empty although the restored notes.txt is in kurenai-os-files (KOS.files.all() = 0 until KOS.files.refresh()). Cloud pulls take the same path (cloudsync.js rerenderCurrent: refreshRailCounters + rerender, no refreshHUD), so a gold/XP change merged from another device also leaves the card stale.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/data-seed-mac.png (rail card Level 1 / 0 gold vs 'Level 53 · ◆12,476' in What a backup covers); shots/assistant-archive/storage-seed-mac.png; eval {g:{xp:71802,gold:12476}, lvl:53, card:'Your profile — Level 1, Healthy, 0 gold'}; eval KOS.files.all().length 0 before refresh, 1 after; js/modules/hub.js:3370-3372; js/core/cloudsync.js:723-731
fix: Give restore and remote-apply one 'state replaced' hook that calls refreshHUD, KOS.files.refresh, the theme apply and the rail counters (or simply reload the page after a restore, as the safest complete answer).
rootCause: Each in-memory cache (HUD, files index) is refreshed only by its own events; replaceState has no broadcast that the caches subscribe to.

title: Storage page leaves dead space: a lone card on the last row and three mostly empty cards stretched to the tallest one
detail: At 1470 the seven cards sit in a 3-column grid: the last row holds only 'Not linked anywhere' with two empty columns beside it, and 'Free up space', 'The biggest files' and 'Duplicates' stretch to the height of 'Files in your cloud' with one line of text each. 'By kind of data' lists four kinds totalling 0 KB under a headline of 47.9 MB used, so most of the usage (state, the media vault) is unexplained.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/storage-seed-mac.png; js/modules/storage.js:127-140
fix: Use the pack/masonry rule Reports uses (last card widens), fold the empty-state cards into one 'Nothing to tidy' line, and add the media vault and the rest of local data to 'By kind of data'.
rootCause: Fixed grid with align-items: stretch and no handling of an odd card count or empty states.

title: Account & Cloud Sync card still says attachment files upload only with 'Sync files now'
detail: The signed-in card reads 'Attachment files upload only with Sync files now.' and the button's title says 'Attachment files upload only when you ask', but since the Files release files under 25 MB upload automatically after each good cycle (Storage › Upload files automatically, on by default; invariant 36). The two Archive pages contradict each other.
evidence: js/modules/cloudui.js:211, :230; js/modules/storage.js:112-115; js/core/cloudsync.js:1207, 1376
fix: Reword to 'Files under 25 MB upload on their own (Storage); Sync files now sends the rest.'
rootCause: Copy not updated when automatic upload shipped.

title: Assistant Settings' 'Simple data requests' route is a dead control: nothing ever asks for the crud category, yet its 'Ollama · no model set' status shows on every Assistant page
detail: Settings › Model control offers four task routes. Every request in the app is sent as 'complex' (the composer, assistant.js:686, :1702), 'tutor' (topic actions, Help, PDF viewer, Creatives, Mind, Code review) or 'generation' (reports, reviews); no caller passes 'crud', so changing the Simple data requests provider, model or fallback has no effect. Its default (Ollama with an empty model) is what the sidebar footer prints as 'Ollama · local — no model set' on every Assistant page, which reads as a broken configuration on an iPad or iPhone where Ollama can never run.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/settings-mac.png, memory-mac.png (footer); grep: the only uses of 'crud' are js/core/ai.js:35,44,87, js/core/aitools.js:3739 (a tool-ranking hint), js/modules/assistant.js:2136,2231; categories passed: assistant.js:686 and :1702 default 'complex'
fix: Either route the composer's short data requests to 'crud' (a real classifier) or remove the row and its footer status; default the route to Gemini rather than an Ollama route with no model.
rootCause: The four-category routing was designed before the single submission path settled on 'complex'; the setting outlived its caller.

title: A scheduled message cannot be edited, its row repeats the time and uses a bare checkbox instead of the app's switch
detail: A saved schedule row offers only On (a native checkbox, where every other on/off in the app is a k-switch), Run now and Delete; changing the time, days or prompt means deleting and re-typing it. The row prints the time twice (the '07:00' badge and '07:00 · Tue · next Tue 10 Nov at 07:00'). Validation order is also odd: with an empty prompt the form first says 'Pick at least one day.' when days are cleared, and with neither the prompt error is not shown first.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/sched-row-mac.png; eval: row controls ['Send Morning plan on schedule' (checkbox), 'Run Morning plan now', 'Delete Morning plan']; toasts ['Pick at least one day.'] with an empty prompt
fix: Add Edit (reuse the form, prefilled), use KOS.ui switch styling, drop the duplicate time from the meta line, and validate the prompt first.
rootCause: Row built as a minimal list item; editing was never implemented.

title: 'What a backup covers' lists six things and omits half of what the file holds (Money, review log, handwriting, Mind's Journal, Creatives work, goals, routines, exams) while saying nothing about what it leaves out
detail: The Data page's coverage card names study progress, the calendar group, the Governor, the media vault, 'The purchase planner and budget history' and attachments. The backup also carries Money transactions, the review log, ink notebooks, Mind's Journal, Creatives works and every study space's state, none of which is listed; and it says nothing about what is NOT included (the Paper library's PDFs, saved Reports, pot pictures), so the user cannot judge whether the file is enough. The 'Document attachments' tile uses '⎘' where the others use a kanji.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/data-iphone.png, data-seed-mac.png; js/modules/hub.js:3405-3432 (six cover() rows); js/core/store.js:513-585 (what snapshotFull actually writes)
fix: Build the list from the same table snapshotFull uses (one row per store with its count) and add a 'Not in the file' line.
rootCause: Coverage text is hand-written and was not extended as stores were added.

title: Permissions offers 'Ask first' for read-only tools, but a read tool set to Ask first still runs without asking
detail: Every non-consequential tool's select offers 'Ask first', including the read tier (e.g. Read schedule, Files list/text, Money overview). effectiveMode() returns 'ask' for it, but the executor only pauses for confirmation when the tool is consequential or (reversible AND mode ask), so a read tool the user tightened to Ask first runs silently. A user who wants to approve, say, files_list or money_transactions before Kurenai reads them gets no approval card.
evidence: eval: schedule_list tier 'read', options ['Default · runs freely','Ask first','Blocked']; js/modules/assistant.js:2517 (Ask first offered when tier !== consequential); js/core/aiorchestrator.js:147-155 (effectiveMode 'ask'), :726 (pause only for consequential or reversible+ask)
fix: Pause whenever mode === 'ask' regardless of tier (keep the read tools' approval card short), or stop offering Ask first on read tools.
rootCause: The pause condition encodes tier rules instead of reading the effective mode.

title: Storage rounds small data to '0 KB' (a 5-byte file, 2 ink pages) while Pen and ink says '1 KB of ink'
detail: storage.js size() rounds to the nearest KB with a floor of 0, so a non-empty file shows '0 KB · Notes' and 'Your ink 0 KB' beside two notebooks, whereas the Pen and ink page reports the same ink as '1 KB'. A zero printed for something that exists reads as broken (invariant 77 spirit).
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/storage-iphone.png ('notes.txt 0 KB · Notes', 'Your ink 0 KB'); Pen and ink storage card '1 page in 2 notebooks · 1 KB of ink on this device'; js/modules/storage.js:22; js/modules/inkset.js:110
fix: Share one byte formatter (ui.js) that prints '< 1 KB' (or bytes) for small non-zero sizes.
rootCause: Two local size formatters with different rounding.

title: Assistant chat header's Project picker and Pin are 21px-tall chips on iPad (touch targets far under 44px)
detail: On iPad (coarse pointer) the thread header's 'Project · none' select is 93x21 and '◇ Pin' is 45x21; the coarse-pointer minimum that lifts other buttons does not reach these k-asst-chip-* controls. They sit in a row with the model chip and ＋, so mis-taps are likely on the user's primary tablet.
evidence: eval at ipad: 'Conversation project' 93x21 (k-asst-chip-select), 'Pin current conversation' 45x21 (k-asst-chip-btn); shots/assistant-archive/chat-head-ipad.png, chat-dawn-mac.png; js/modules/assistant.js:1811, :2026
fix: Give the header chips the touch block-size under (pointer: coarse) (padding or a ::before hit area that does not overlap neighbours, invariant 69).
rootCause: Chip styles are desktop-dense and outside the global touch rule's selector.

title: Archive pages disagree on their kicker: 'The archive · 通' on Backup, Help and Notifications, 'Settings · 庫' on Storage, Pen and ink and Connections
detail: Seven pages share one Archive tab strip, but three are headed 'THE ARCHIVE · <kanji>' and three 'SETTINGS · <kanji>' (Files is a third style). Only Connections carries a painted page-header band; the other Archive pages have none.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/notif-seeded-mac.png, data-seed-mac.png, help-seed-mac.png vs storage-seed-mac.png, pen-seed-mac.png, connections-seed-mac.png, storage-empty-ipad.png
fix: Use one kicker ('The archive · <kanji>') for every page in the strip and decide whether all Archive pages get the band or none.
rootCause: Pages built at different times each pass their own pageHeader kicker.

title: A fresh install's first notification is backdated: '23 plan topics carried over into this week', dated Monday 08:00, before the app existed
detail: On an empty account opened on Friday 6 November, the feed already holds the Pacing carry-over notice timestamped Monday 2 November 08:00, telling a brand-new user they are behind on 23 rows of the seeded plan, plus a Morning Review about the SAMPLE mock exam. A first open greets the user with backlog they never had.
evidence: shots/assistant-archive/notif-empty-mac.png (reset slot: 'MONDAY 2 NOVEMBER · 23 plan topics carried over into this week · 08:00')
fix: Do not raise pace:carry for weeks that ended before the install (state.created), and stamp a notice with the time it was raised, not the week start.
rootCause: The carry-over notice is derived from the seeded plan's week dates with no reference to when the account began.
